Descriptive statistics computed by analysis/SI_behavior_stats.py -> analysis/SI_behavior_stats.json (no PnL, no event studies, no parameter selection; strict past/trailing windows). Key measured findings: (1) SI's LIQUID cycle is H/K/N/U/Z only - all 10 serial contracts are dead (max 944 lots/day on SIV6, the S1 'front'; cycle months 26k-178k) - so any front/roll logic must use the cycle chain, and S6's SI spread number was measured on the dead serial book; (2) declared roll rule (last session before delivery month) is well-aligned with measured liquidity migration (next contract >=10k lots 2-7 days before roll, 6/6 cycles; old book 22-376 lots at roll); (3) roll gaps positive 6/6 (median +0.565 USD/oz = 113 ticks = $2,825/contract; mean +0.97%/roll ~ +5.2%/yr contango) - old-leg close is a thin tail book (caveat recorded); (4) true-volume front chain = 2025-07-01..2026-10-01 (316 days; earlier history only deferred-contract settlement marks); (5) sample is ONE squeeze-and-crash regime: 36.4 -> 115.5 (2026-01-26, +217%) -> 61.2, incl. +14.0% and -31.4% single RTH days on 170k+ lots; daily vol 3.79% (60.2% ann), skew -1.81, exkurt +15.2; overnight-gap std = 86% of daily std; (6) GC/SI ratio spanned 44.0->92.8 in 7 months then reverted past median (now 68.7, 69.8th pctile of trailing 63d); SI-GC corr 0.828 full-sample (rolling 0.65-0.91), %-elasticity ~1.9 median; (7) liquid-era close-proxy spread median-of-medians 4 ticks = $100/contract (2->8 ticks across eras), 0 crossed days in liquid windows; the dataset's only crossed close day (2026-05-21) is on the dead serial book. 5 hypotheses specified with full template + PARAM-GAPs (cycle-chain construction; GC/SI ratio reversion; contango-carry sign; convex GC beta; overnight-gap tail clustering). Missing-data table prioritized (multi-year daily chain, intraday depth incl. overnight session, OI, CoT history free, HG copper absent from corpus, rates/lease rates, consensus archive, BBO depth).
